name: Changelog
summary: Dated release notes for shadcn/ui: components, CLI, registries and packages from 2023 to 2026.
description: The shadcn/ui changelog collects dated entries on new components and features: the cn package that replaces clsx and tailwind-merge (with an npx migration), private GitHub registries read through the GitHub CLI, human-in-the-loop helpers for the AI SDK, the Questionnaire component with install commands, and server-side dynamic search for registries. An index links every earlier update back to 2023.
